text:
zoe: FYI our premerge SAST started failing after the key-rewrap this morning. lots of aborted runs and missing artifacts. cc @sre-oncall

paul: i rotated the keyring and applied the new policy at 09:02 UTC. i thought i included the scanner SA but logs suggest decrypt failures. investigating now.

ina: CI snippet: `KMS.Decrypt: permission denied` then scanner exits before uploading raw bundles. sample log:
```
> Fetching artifacts...
> kms.Decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller lacks permission to decrypt
> scanner: exiting with status 1
```

sec-bot: alert: scan-failure-rate spike from 1.5% -> 64% in 12m. automatic triage may create duplicate tickets.

zoe: mitigation proposal: (1) create a short-lived IAM binding for svc-scanner, (2) do a smokecheck of scan pipeline, (3) persist raw encrypted bundles to GS before decrypt step, (4) tag vuln tickets with `scan:rotation-smoke` for filtering.

paul: i'll add a conditional binding (30m) and post the audit entry id here. planned command:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-23T09:35:00Z"),title=tmp_scanner_decrypt'
```

paul: audit id (redacted): Z9Y8X7W6V5 at 09:06 UTC. binding is live.

nina: add this small GH step so artifacts are always preserved even on decrypt error:
```
- name: Preserve raw bundle
  run: |
    tar -czf raw-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz scanner-output || true
    gsutil cp raw-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/ || true
```

triage-bot: created SEC-6120 "Scan aborts after key rewrap" tags: [scan:rotation-smoke, priority-medium] assigned to @zoe

sre-oncall: muting noisy alerts for 45m while re-runs proceed. i'll monitor backlog and page SLOs. :white_check_mark: 

zoe: follow-ups: paul confirm removal of temporary binding after re-runs (due 40m), nina land preservation step in scan template (due EOD), triage-bot ensure tickets from re-runs get the `scan:rotation-smoke` tag, sre-oncall report re-run success counts (due 1h).

paul: will remove temp binding after re-run and post final audit entry. thanks.

zoe: root cause candidate: key rewrap applied without revalidating scanner SA binding + no artifact-preserve step. we'll spin a short postmortem with a smokecheck checklist for future rotations. :memo:
